verdict.rationale: The MI325X ships with a substantial official software ecosystem (ROCm, AMD SMI, GPU Operator, Metrics Exporter), so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. No evidence shows one: the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on the ROCm docs returned 404, and the llms.txt file is documentation, not an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
